description_en: Retrieves the details of data event selectors for a specified trail
description_zh: 本接口用于获取指定跟踪名称的数据事件选择器详细信息
name: GetDataEventSelector

DataEventSelectors.description_en:
The data event selector configuration. The value is a JSON array with a maximum of 20 elements.

The following fields are included in each element of the JSON array:

`ServiceName`: The name of the cloud service that supports data events.
`ReadWriteType`: Read, Write, or All.
`EventName`: Contains two fields: Equals and NotEquals.

  For example, the following configuration specifies that only GetObject, CopyObject, and AppendObject events are delivered:

  `{"EventName":{"Equals":["GetObject","CopyObject","AppendObject"]}}`

  If NotEquals is used, events other than GetObject, CopyObject, and AppendObject are delivered.

`ResourceArn`: Contains two fields: Equals and NotEquals, similar to `EventName`. For example:

  `{"ResourceArn":{"Equals":[arn1,...,arnx]}}`
DataEventSelectors.description_zh:
数据事件选择器配置。以json数组形式表示，数组大小上限为20。

json数组中每个元素字段说明：

`ServiceName`：支持的数据事件云产品名称
`ReadWriteType`： Read、Write、All
`EventName`：内含两种字段，Equals与NotEquals

  例如：如下配置代表只有GetObject、CopyObject、AppendObject的事件会被投递：

  `{"EventName":{"Equals":["GetObject","CopyObject","AppendObject"]}}`

  如果是NotEquals，代表不等于GetObject、CopyObject、AppendObject的事件会被投递。

`ResourceArn`：也是内含两种字段，Equals与NotEquals，参考`EventName`。例如：

  `{"ResourceArn":{"Equals":[arn1,...,arnx]}}`

IsTrailAllRegion.description_en: Indicates whether the trail applies to all regions

SlsDeliveryConfigs.description_en: The list of Simple Log Service delivery configurations

items.description_en: The Simple Log Service delivery configuration object

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the Simple Log Service delivery resource initialization record was created in the current region. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
CreateTime.description_zh: 当前地域的SLS投递资源初始化记录的创建时间。时间遵循ISO 8601标准，使用 UTC 时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when resource initialization fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 资源初始化失败时返回的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when resource initialization fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 资源初始化失败时返回的错误信息

RegionSlsProjectArn.description_en: The ARN of the regional Simple Log Service project to which the trail delivers events
RegionSlsProjectArn.description_zh: 跟踪投递的区域日志服务项目ARN

Status.description_en:
The resource initialization status of the trail.

success: Successful.
failure: Failed
Status.description_zh:
跟踪的资源初始化状态

success-成功
failure-失败
